name: trade

list.description: Native individual FX trades from RiskStandardTrade.

parameters.name: trade-id
parameters.description: Native transaction number, queried through uniqueIds.

parameters.name: from-time
parameters.description: Inclusive ISO calendar date (UTC+08 full-day expansion) or explicit-offset/Z instant with seconds and 1–3 fractional digits; unknown offsets and higher precision are rejected. Paired bounds required; omitted ID and bounds freezes yesterday before persistence.

parameters.name: to-time
parameters.description: Inclusive ISO calendar date (UTC+08 full-day expansion) or explicit-offset/Z instant with seconds and 1–3 fractional digits; unknown offsets and higher precision are rejected. Paired bounds required; omitted ID and bounds freezes yesterday before persistence.

identity_description: Native uniqueId is the transaction number and identifies each FX trade record; outBizNo is the separate customer order reference.
limitations: Business filters are online only; cached mappings are unverified.
Acquisition is bounded to 100 pages and 120 seconds.
Field types describe verified native representations; fields may be absent or null, unknown fields are preserved, and documentation never coerces records.
Native totalCount counts transaction-number records in the requested scope. Duplicate identities, content conflicts or count gaps leave the result incomplete and prevent refresh publication.
Use a narrow qualified scope with BCode, scene, symbol, transaction type, fulfilled status and paired dates. Broad date-only or BCode-only inquiries may fail in the backend.
Repeated acquisitions cannot prove an immutable backend snapshot or stable ordering for every scope.
